A full op:// reference to the Atlas key (L18)
Why titles first, IDs as fallback

op:// references can't carry the em dashes in our titles (1Password: unsupported characters need the ID), so scripts look the title up with op item list (IDs and titles only) and read by ID. A title that two items share stops the script unless the fallback is one of them. So never save a personal copy under a shared title: the scripts would keep reading the fallback ID.
